quotes.text: I remember sitting in the back of a lecture hall at Reed thinking, this is the most boring delivery of a genuinely fascinating idea I have ever encountered in my life, and wondering why nobody seemed bothered by that. That tension never really left me.

quotes.text: My mother watched the Oscar ceremony from a hospital room in 1994 and I wasn't allowed to call her until after the broadcast ended because she didn't want to miss the Best Picture announcement. She didn't even have a bet on it. That's just who she was about movies.
